# The expected public set — DOOR 1 (Cloudflare Workers Static Assets).
#
# Every path below is a file this repository INTENDS to serve at https://squidbay.ai/.
# `.github/ci/publish-set.mjs` reads the boundary from wrangler.toml, walks that asset root,
# applies the asset root's `.assetsignore`, and fails on any path that would publish and is
# not listed here.
#
# ── PATH FORM CHANGED 2026-08-16. READ THIS BEFORE EDITING. ──────────────────────────
# `[assets] directory` moved from "." to "public", so a served file's REPOSITORY path and
# its URL are no longer the same string. Paths here are REPOSITORY-root-relative:
#
#     public/site.css      is the repository path
#     /site.css            is the URL it answers at
#
# Repository-relative is deliberate. It encodes the publish boundary into the gate's own
# input, so if anyone moves `[assets] directory` again every line here goes red and a human
# has to look. Had these stayed URL-shaped they would have survived a silent boundary change
# unchanged — which is the exact failure mode this door exists to catch.
#
# HOW TO CHANGE IT — the whole point is that this file is edited on purpose:
#   * a new page, image, stylesheet or script that visitors should reach → add its path here
#   * anything else that turned up in the publish set → add a pattern to
#     `public/.assetsignore` instead, so it never uploads. Config, source, build tools and CI
#     inputs go here never.
#   Do not do both. If a path is denied it must not be listed; the gate prints a STALE line
#   for any entry nothing publishes at.
#
# This file lives under .github/, which is OUTSIDE the asset root — so the expected set can
# never publish itself. That was previously true because `.assetsignore` denied `.github`;
# it is now true by construction, which is the better guarantee.
#
# This list covers ONE of two public doors. GitHub Pages does not read `.assetsignore` and
# nothing in this file constrains it; that door is asserted by `.github/ci/pages-off.mjs`.
#
# Regenerated 2026-08-16 from the moved tree and verified against it: 84 files under the
# asset root, 1 denied (`.assetsignore`, which wrangler never uploads), 92 published — the
# 92 below. The count is unchanged from the pre-move set of 92, and the two sets were diffed
# with the `public/` prefix stripped: IDENTICAL. Every URL this site serves is the same
# address it was before the move.
